notes: Fix: the in-app updater showed a perpetual 'update available' that never took. The published exe's internal version lagged the manifest by one (a build/version-bump ordering slip), so an updated app still reported the older version and re-offered the same update forever. This build bakes the correct version. Also includes 1.0.46-1.0.48: CSV heat/process analysis export, 26 labware formats with per-format recipes, and USB-HID + serial barcode scanner support.
